module.purpose: Defines the application-wide server-rendered document shell for Next.js, establishing localized document metadata, content security handling, theme initialization, embedded-page behavior, and standard browser assets.
module.summary: This custom document integrates request-time locale detection, text direction, content security nonces, and embed URL detection into the server-rendered HTML structure. It safely propagates security headers, initializes client-side locale and theme state, renders favicon and manifest metadata, conditionally loads preview instrumentation, and preserves Next.js application content and scripts.
module.businessContext:
Supports a localized scheduling and booking product across standalone and embedded experiences.
Failure can break page security, localization, theming, browser branding, or iframe rendering.
